reconstruction_notes.en: Original three-dimensional irregular open-cell glass-strut foam with rounded continuous junctions and through-connected large voids, based on USGS basic reticulite definition. Original coarse13-cell construction is a visible teaching abstraction, not measured bubble count/porosity, exact specimen, deposit or eruption reconstruction. Entire interior is strut network, no opaque rock core or surface-only tafoni. Unequal cell spacing, gently bowed thin struts and restrained opaque brown glass impression; no industrial equal grid, copied model, transparency dependence or texture. Nominal0.16m largest span is art scale.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创三维不规则开孔玻璃杆泡沫，圆润连续节点及互相贯通大孔依据USGS网状火山玻璃基本定义。原创粗化13泡单元构造为可见教学抽象，不是泡数/孔隙率测量、精确标本、矿床或喷发复原。内部全部为杆网，不含不透明岩核或仅表面蜂窝风化。泡孔间距不等、细杆微弯，克制不透明棕玻璃感；不是工业等距晶格，不复制模型，不依靠透明或贴图。0.16米最大名义展幅为美术尺度。
